# adapter

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments/resolution/domain/adapter"
```

Package adapter implements the Domain resolution Adapter.

This file owns the Adapter — a thin struct wrapper around resolve.ResolveDomain. The Adapter satisfies interface\-based injection points in the application layer where a concrete resolution dependency must be passed as a value rather than called as a free function.

Stateless by design — all resolution logic lives in the resolve package. Future deps \(client, logger\) will be wired here when cross\-CR reads or observability hooks are required. Until then, resolution is pure and nothing is needed at construction time.

See also:

- resolution/domain/resolve — resolution entry point and types
- resolution/domain/contract — one\-way proto projection
- pkg/domain/application/service.go — primary consumer of Adapter.Resolve

## type [Adapter](<https://github.com/blanketops/environments/blob/main/resolution/domain/adapter/adapter.go#L48-L52>)

Adapter wraps the Domain resolution function for interface\-based injection. Stateless — all resolution logic lives in resolve.ResolveDomain.

Planned future deps \(add when needed\):

- client client.Client — for cross\-CR reads \(e.g. verifying Route ownership\)
- log logr.Logger — for resolution observability
